paite: Hiaite ahi Israel suante'n Kanaan gam alak ua, siampu Eleazar, Nun tapa Joshua leh Israel suante nam inkuan lupente'n agouluah ding ua ana hawm uh.
heading: Jordan Tumlam Gam Hawmna

paite: Nam kuate leh nam kimkhatte a tuam dia TOUPA'N Mosi zang a thu ana piak bang in aisan in agouluah uh piak ahi.
Mosi in nam nih leh nam kimkhatte Jordan gal ah agouluah ding uh ana peta hi. Levi chite bel alak uah gouluah ding ape kei hi.

Joseph suante nam nih ahi ua, Manasseh leh Ephraim. Levi chite huai gam ah tantuam ape kei uh, a-omna ding uh khopite leh adaikim ua gantatna ding mun leh a-inn leh alou uh bawlna ding lou ngal piak ahi kei uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in Israel suante'n ahih ua, gam ahawm uhi.

Judah suante Gilgal ah Joshua kiang ah ava hoh ua; Keniz mi Jephunneh tapa Kaleb in akiang ah, "Kadesh-barnea mun a Pathian mipa Mosi kiang a TOUPA'N ka tungtang leh na tungtang thu ana gen na thei hi.
heading: Kaleb Kiang Ah Hebron Piak Ahi

paite: TOUPA sikha Mosi in Kadesh-barnea mun a pan gam va enkhe dia ahon sawl lai in kum sawmli a upa ka na hita a; ka lungsim a om bangtak akiang ah ka tun nawn hi.
Himahleh ka unau ka kiang a pai samte'n mipite lungtang azulsuaksak ua; ke'n bel TOUPA ka Pathian ka zui hi.
Mosi in huai ni in, TOUPA ka Pathian na zuih ziak in na khe in ana siksa gam tangtawn in nang leh na suante gouluah ahi ngeingei ding, chi in akichiam hi.

Huchi in ngai in, TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a huai thute agen nung Israelte gamdai a, avakvaih sung un TOUPA'N agensa bang in kum sawmli-le-nga tak ahon damsak lai hi. Ngai in, tu in kum sawmgiat-le-nga ka hita.
Hichi pipi in leng Mosi in ahon sawl lai mah bang in ka hat lai a, nidanglai a kidouna ding leh nasep silbawlna dia thagui ka neih mah bang in tu in leng ka nei lai hi.

Huaiziak in hiai tang, TOUPA'N huai ni a agensa pen hon pia in, Anakte a-om ua, akhopite uh athupi a, kulhbaang a umsuak ahi uh, chih huai ni in na za a; TOUPA'N ahon ompih dia, amaute ka delhkhe thei ding, TOUPA'N ana gensa bang in," achi hi.
Joshua in avualzawl a; Jephunneh tapa Kaleb gouluah ding in Hebron khua apeta hi.
Huaiziak in Hebron khua tuni tan in Keniz mi, Jephunneh tapa Kaleb gouluah ahong hita hi; TOUPA Israelte' Pathian azuih ziak in.
Hebron kho min ama in Kiriath-arba ahi. Arba ahihleh Anakte lak a mithupipen ahi. Huai khit in agam ahong galmuangta hi.
